decisive_items: epithelial cells were positive for cytokeratin AE1/E3 and negative for estrogen receptor, progesterone receptor, and HER2/neu
no axillary lymphadenopathy or skin thickening was identified
response.rationale: The IHC profile is diagnostic of triple-negative breast cancer, whereas inflammatory breast cancer is contradicted by absent skin changes and no skin thickening or lymphadenopathy on MRI.

rejected.why: Inflammatory breast cancer requires skin erythema/edema and typically diffuse involvement; the vignette explicitly notes no overlying skin changes and no skin thickening, and the biopsy IHC supports triple-negative breast cancer instead.
